verdict.rationale: Elicit documents its own bulk PDF upload into the Library with no stated limit, plus Zotero and RIS/BIB import. Collections can launch reviews or extractions over those papers, and Zotero imports support extracting data and analyzing your papers. The evidence never states that the Research Agent itself researches over a user-uploaded corpus, so the 'agent researches over them' part is only implied through extraction, review and chat workflows. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the Research Agent can be scoped to uploaded PDFs or a user corpus, hands-on or independent corroboration of research over uploaded files, and documented limits or quality of agent reasoning over the user's own corpus.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can upload my own PDFs or corpus and have the agent research over them

citations.quote: There is no limit on the number of PDFs your library can hold at this time.
When uploading PDFs, simply click the "Add tags" button to create a tag or add an existing one to your newly uploaded papers.
Elicit's Zotero integration helps you bring your paper collections into Elicit, where you can extract data and analyze your papers!
Collections help you group related research, arrange it the way you want, share it with colleagues, and quickly launch reviews or extractions.
You can import RIS and BIB files into Elicit.
